newsitem.title: USA: Morgens group sells MK Rail stake.
newsitem.headline: Morgens group sells MK Rail stake.

text.p: A group including Morgens Waterfall Income Partners, a New York investment firm, said Thursday it sold its stake of about 7.1 percent in MK Rail Corp.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 1,243,202 shares of MK Rail between Oct 29 and Nov 25 at $7.50 to $7.l625 a share.
The group said it sold the shares in the ordinary course of its business.

MK Rail is a Pittsburgh, Pa., maker and distributor of engineered locomotive parts. MK Rail previously announced it would change its name to MotivePower Industries Inc beginning Jan 1 and begin trading under a new stock symbol "MOPO."
